M40 — 2026-10-12
Installing a just-published rc: `npm i -g sofar.sh@next` can resolve the PREVIOUS rc for a while from npm's local metadata cache even after the registry's next tag moved (0.37.0-rc.7, 2026-10-12). Install the exact version with `--prefer-online` (`npm i -g sofar.sh@<version> --include=optional --prefer-online`), then run `sofar --version` once: with npm 12's blocked install script, the first sofar run activates the new core in ~/.local/share/sofar/core/current (A12).
